spec_case: issue #600 item 3 (cof and electricity agree: a reflector-generated plan's secret reference is never absorbed by on_error)
description: A reflector-generated plan names a secret in an http header, untrusted like any generated plan. The reflector's own loop always re-raises a generated child's failure regardless of on_error -- core/reflector.py::ReflectorRuntime.execute never reads an on_error field, which ReflectorDefinition doesn't even carry -- so on_error: continue on the reflector effect never absorbs it, on either engine; the whole run fails with the generated child's own secret-placement text.
